subject: Post-discovery ops orientation: ClearWave technical review
messages:
From: Alyssa Mendoza <alyssa@clearwave.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery — ops/infra orientation request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today — that was helpful. We'd like to move to a technical orientation with your infra/ops folks to validate fit and get an initial topology recommendation. Goals for the session:

- Walk through a sample deployment topology (VPC/private vs hosted routing).
- Discuss throughput and batching expectations for 10–20 TPS sustained, inferred at 512 tokens.
- Surface security/compliance touchpoints (audit logs, retention, KMS).
- Confirm what telemetry and traces we can get for production (Token-level cost breakdowns, per-route latency).

Prefer a 60–90 minute slot that includes your pre-sales engineer + solutions architect. Our CISO (Mark Jennings) may join for the security portion.

Availability windows (PST):
- Mon 5/24: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Tue 5/25: 09:30–12:00
- Wed 5/26: afternoons after 13:00

Also attaching our internal questionnaire (MAT-PQ) for the security portion — it will help focus the conversation. Can you confirm whether a recording is okay (we have sensitive logs, so we may redact after)?

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Mendoza
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
ClearWave Health
Attachment: ClearWave_MATPQ.pdf (pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Mendoza <alyssa@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery — ops/infra orientation request

Hi Alyssa — great to hear from you and glad the discovery was useful. We can absolutely run the orientation and tailor the agenda to the items you listed.

Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Soojin Lee (Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference)
- Ben Carter (Pre-sales Engineer)
- Karthik Iyer (Solutions Architect)

We can do a 75-minute session to cover the topology + security + perf expectations. From your windows, we have the following open (PST):
- Tue 5/25 10:00–11:15
- Tue 5/25 11:30–12:45
- Wed 5/26 13:30–14:45

Recording is fine — we understand the need to manage sensitive logs. We'll stop recording for any redacted screen shares and provide a summary deck instead.

Two quick asks before the call so we can prepare:
1) Can you share the MAT-PQ file (looks like you attached a reference) and call out any non-standard compliance requirements?
2) Are you planning to discuss sample data flows that include PHI in the session? If yes, we'll mask specific examples in the demo.

I'll send a calendar invite once you pick a slot and include a short pre-read (topology diagram + a perf benchmark excerpt).

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Alyssa Mendoza <alyssa@clearwave.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Mark Jennings <mark.jennings@clearwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery — ops/infra orientation request

Thanks — Tue 5/25 11:30–12:45 PST works for us. I've attached the MAT-PQ and our security questionnaire export so you can skim ahead.

Also: procurement note — we need a mutual NDA before sharing a sample dataset in the session. Do you have a standard one we can sign quickly? Our procurement lead is on a tight timeline next week.

Selected slot: Tue 25 May 2027, 11:30–12:45 PST (please confirm invite).

Regards,
Alyssa
Attachment: ClearWave_Security_Questions.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Mendoza <alyssa@clearwave.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery — ops/infra orientation request

Perfect — we've penciled that in. Quick note on agenda and logistics (draft):

Agenda (75 mins):
- 0–10m: Introductions + success criteria
- 10–35m: Topology walkthrough (hosted vs private VPC, network egress)
- 35–55m: Performance and batching expectations (KV cache behavior, throughput at 512 tokens)
- 55–65m: Security & compliance Q&A (KMS, audit logs, retention policies)
- 65–75m: Next steps and mutual action plan

Is Mark your CISO? If so, could you add him to the calendar invite so we can allocate ~15 minutes for his questions?

Also sharing a short pre-read link: https://drive.google.com/clearwave/pre-reads — I'll drop a topology PNG and a one-page perf note there now.

If procurement needs an NDA, we have a standard mutual NDA — I can route it today and share a DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Pre-sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>

Confirmed — I've sent a calendar invite for Tue, 25 May 2027 11:30–12:45 PST and included Mark. Meeting link and agenda are on the invite.

Next steps on our side before the call:
- Ben will upload the 1-pg perf note and topology PNG to the Drive link you shared.
- I'll circulate a 2-slide pre-read summarizing how Redwood routes requests, caching behavior, and a short checklist for the security Q&A.
- I'll also send a DocuSign for the mutual NDA so you can route to procurement; we can pause any sample-data demo until that's executed.

If anything changes on your side, please reply-all and we'll adjust. Looking forward to the session.

Thanks,
